purpose: Define which import/export profile pairs claim semantic roundtrip equivalence and how lossless versus lossy formats are distinguished.

value.profile_rule: Each format pair explicitly declares `lossless_semantic_roundtrip`, `lossy_projection` or `unsupported_roundtrip`.
value.lossless_rule: Lossless roundtrip must preserve canonical identity, refs, meaningful order, value distinctions and ownership-relevant semantics.
value.lossy_rule: Lossy profile declares dropped/unrepresentable semantic dimensions.
value.byte_rule: Semantic roundtrip does not require byte-identical serialization unless a separate byte-preservation profile says so.
value.test_rule: Lossless profiles must pass golden roundtrip fixtures.
value.version_rule: Roundtrip claim is tied to exact import/export profile/version.
value.failure_rule: A lossy profile cannot be used as authoritative canonical backup without explicit acceptance of the loss.
